comment: Written for gEdit (synthetic, not for a machine); see README.md here.
description: Siemens two channels: in channel 1 a GOTOF L1 stands alone in an IF R1==1 … ENDIF block and would jump over WAITM(2,1,2); channel 2 has no mark 2. The jump runs only when R1 is 1, so channel 1 may reach WAITM(2,1,2) and wait there for ever. The jump is inside an IF block, so it is not followed: the missing partner of mark 2 is reported, before and after.

1: ; WRITTEN FOR GEDIT - SYNTHETIC TEST PROGRAM, NOT FOR A MACHINE
2: ; WRITTEN FOR GEDIT - SYNTHETIC TEST PROGRAM, NOT FOR A MACHINE
